title: BusinessProcess
description: IT domain composite for BusinessProcess, materializing its applicable cross-framework facets. Typing: extends BusinessProcess (rootless — qualifier/data roles only). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties. Mount-key distinctness within one composite is the author's responsibility now that titles are no longer framework-prefixed). Mounted facets — attributed-to: Attribution; measured-by-quality-in-use: ProductContextCoverage, ProductEffectiveness, ProductEfficiency, ProductFreedomFromRisk, ProductSatisfaction. Source: hand-authored, TOGAF business-architecture stratum.
